title: Phase Shift
description: Navigate a particle through a lab experiment with two phase states. Toggle between phases to bypass barriers. Solve 20 increasingly tricky levels.
detailedDescription: A physics-inspired puzzle game where you control a subatomic particle navigating a quantum interference experiment. Your particle exists in two phase states - Phase A and Phase B - and each level contains barriers that are permeable in one phase but solid in the other. Switch between phases to weave through the maze, collect energy nodes, and reach the exit portal. The 20 hand-crafted levels introduce new mechanics: moving barriers, phase-locked doors, teleporters, and quantum entanglement nodes. Clean, minimalist lab aesthetic with subtle particle effects.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move. Spacebar or Q to toggle between Phase A and Phase B. Reach the green exit portal to clear each level.
